name: Rabbi
overview: The title 'Rabbi' in Scripture denotes a Jewish teacher and is used in respectful address toward figures such as John the Baptist and Jesus. However, Jesus warns against His disciples adopting the title, emphasizing that there is only one Master, Christ, and all believers are brethren (Matthew 23:7-8). While the term is used in various contexts, including by Judas and Peter addressing Jesus as 'Master' or 'Rabbi' (Matthew 26:25, Mark 9:5), Jesus Himself is also called 'Rabboni,' a term of deep respect (Mark 10:51). This teaching highlights the proper recognition of authority in Christ rather than human titles.
